title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 49
paragraphs: When the commanders had assembled at Salamis from the states mentioned, they began to deliberate. Eurybiades proposed that anyone who wished should declare his opinion as to where it was most suitable to fight a sea-battle in the regions under their control; Attica had already been given up, and he was now putting the question about the other places. The opinions of the speakers mostly agreed that they should sail to the Isthmus and there fight a sea-battle in defense of the Peloponnese, arguing that if they were defeated while at Salamis they would be blockaded on an island with no help coming, whereas at the Isthmus they could land among their own countrymen.
